# Emerson Herrera Tolentino

> Software engineer specialising in production Generative AI and RAG systems, with 8+ years building software for banking, telecom, health and education. Currently at Canvia, building a multi-tenant RAG platform that serves four Central Reserve Bank of Peru (BCRP) applications.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio (English)](https://portfolio.certilab.app/): Experience, AI work, research, projects, skills and education.
- [Portafolio (Español)](https://portfolio.certilab.app/es): Spanish version of the portfolio.
- [Portfólio (Português)](https://portfolio.certilab.app/pt): Portuguese version of the portfolio.

## Case studies

- [Multi-tenant RAG platform for BCRP](https://portfolio.certilab.app/case-studies/bcrp-rag): Multi-tenant RAG platform bringing grounded search and assistant experiences to four BCRP applications.
- [Certilab RAG for calibration certificates](https://portfolio.certilab.app/case-studies/certilab-rag): A certification product and RAG foundation that turns calibration certificates into searchable, traceable decision support.
